Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, docs, compound_structures. Join: Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, join compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1126800'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
